title: Acceptance test report — Demo Shop
subtitle: Executed by scenescout check on {date} at {time} UTC

sections.heading: Purpose
paragraphs: This report records the automated execution of the demo shop's acceptance tests. Each test is a saved flow; each row is one of its steps, with the result the step was expected to bring about and what it did.
A step passes or fails on its assertions alone. A step that fails is listed again under Deviations.
Each deviation is assessed by the reviewer before the report is approved.
The SHA-256 of each file shows it is the one the run wrote.

roles.meaning: I ran these tests as described and the evidence is complete.
I reviewed the results and every deviation.
I approve the results recorded in this report.
